snippet.title: exA-Arcadia『カオスコード ネメシスエクスペリメント』| CHAOS CODE NEMESIS EXPERIMENT for Arcades | Attract Video
snippet.description:
CHAOS CODE NEMESIS EXPERIMENT for Arcades on exA-Arcadia
Available Now

Players: 1-2
Genre: Fighter
Monitor: Horizontal
Languages: English, Japanese

FEATURES

ALL NEW SEQUEL
CHAOS CODE finally returns with an all new installment

16 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Choose from 16 unique characters each with selectable skills and bounce styles

FOR FIGHTER FANS
Designed for the players - there are no modern shortcuts or compromises!

STORY MODE
Each character has a different story sequence and endings.  

TRAINING MODE
Practice battle situations against any character. Setup the CPU to do tech recoveries or give yourself maximum resources to go for the best combos!

2 FRAMES INPUT LAG RESPONSE – The fastest benchmark in the game industry
Maximum Performance! Play like you’re meant to. Never miss a combo again.
